name: Scarlet Crusade Documents
summary: These intercepted papers were carried by a Scarlet Crusade messenger dispatched from the Scarlet Monastery to the camps near Deathknell. Containing orders for the Crusade's field commanders across Tirisfal Glades, they provide the Forsaken with the exact military intelligence needed to target the Crusade's regional leadership.

sections.title: Intercepted Orders
sections.body: Dispatched straight from the Scarlet Monastery, the courier Meven Korgal carried these documents toward the Crusade's southern encampment outside Deathknell. Issued by order of the Highlord, the directives are addressed to the captains of the Crusade's Tirisfal Regional Command: Captain Perrine is to further fortify the southwest tower and gather information on the undead in Brill, Captain Vachon to crush undead movement near the northern tower, and Captain Melrose to watch the borders of the Plaguelands. The documents reveal the names, posts, and orders of Scarlet field officers stationed across Tirisfal Glades, turning an otherwise routine courier run into a catastrophic intelligence breach for the zealots.

sections.title: Delivery to Brill
sections.body: Executor Arren swiftly recognized that local forces in Deathknell could not exploit the full breadth of the intelligence. Instead, the captured dossier serves as a newly awakened Forsaken's passport out of Deathknell. Carried northeast past Cold Hearth Manor into Brill, the documents are handed directly to Executor Zygand outside the Brill Town Hall. With these orders in hand, the Forsaken military leadership plans swift decapitation strikes against Scarlet commanders entrenched across the Glades.

faq.answer: They were carried by Meven Korgal, a Scarlet Crusade courier sent from the Scarlet Monastery down to the Crusade's encampment southeast of Deathknell.

faq.q: What information is inside the documents?
faq.answer: The bundle holds directives, by order of the Highlord, to the captains of the Crusade's Tirisfal Regional Command: Captain Perrine is to fortify the southwest tower and scout the undead in Brill, Captain Vachon to deal with undead movement near the northern tower, and Captain Melrose to watch the borders of the Plaguelands.

faq.q: Who needs to see these documents?
aliases: who do i give the documents to
faq.answer: After being recovered for Executor Arren in Deathknell, they are entrusted to you for delivery to Executor Zygand, who oversees regional military efforts outside Brill Town Hall.

faq.q: Why are these documents important to the Forsaken?
faq.answer: The captured orders pinpoint Crusade officer deployments throughout Tirisfal Glades, giving the Forsaken the upper hand to eliminate enemy leadership and shatter the zealots' regional morale.

angles.text: Carrying these intercepted papers marks an awakened Forsaken's graduation from the cemetery trials of Deathknell into the wider war effort directed from Brill.
